paraphrase: While Nāropa was a scholar at Nālandā an ugly old woman asked whether he understood the words or the meaning; when he said the words she laughed, when he said the meaning she wept, telling him that only her brother Tilopa understood the meaning; he left to seek Tilopa.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally.

paraphrase: Nāropa underwent twelve great and twelve lesser hardships at Tilopa's command (leaping from a temple roof, into fire, and so on), each followed by an instruction; finally Tilopa struck him with a sandal and he realized the nature of mind.
